evals.prompt: Can you screenshot https://news.ycombinator.com and tell me what the top story is right now?
evals.expected_output: Screenshot saved, top story identified from page content.

assertions.text: Used passe look or passe run with screenshot verb, not curl/chromium directly
Top story title correctly identified in response
Completed in 3 or fewer passe commands

evals.prompt: I need to read this article but there's a cookie wall: https://www.spiegel.de/international/. Can you get past it and get me the content?
evals.expected_output: Cookie wall scouted (or detected absent), content extracted.

assertions.text: Scouted for cookie buttons before clicking (ax-find, snapshot, or screenshot inspection)
Did not guess cookie button text without scouting first
Extracted page content to a readable file
Used passe verbs, not curl/requests/chromium directly

evals.prompt: Can you check https://httpbin.org/html exists and has the text 'Herman Melville' on it? I want a screenshot as proof too.
evals.expected_output: Verification result (pass/fail), screenshot saved as proof.

assertions.text: Used passe check with --contains or passe run with assert verb
Correctly reported that 'Herman Melville' is present
Used passe verbs, not curl/chromium directly
